precondition: unique dimension-specific inclusive validator uses row count for hline and column count for vline, including non-square matrices

variants.transform: reject valid boundary offset equal to dimension
clamp invalid magnitude to the nearest boundary
validate hline against columns and vline against rows

variant_killers.M25e-swap-dimension: on a 2x3 matrix hline 3 reports dimension 2 and vline 4 reports dimension 3, while valid boundary hline 2/vline 3 emits both lines; on 3x2 valid hline 3/vline 2 also emits both

validity: Every variant must preserve valid inclusive borders and produce the correct dimension-specific rejection for both signs and axes. M25e requires both non-square orientations and both valid/invalid controls.
